clauses.requirement: Resolve the qualification prefix, then use visible resolution for the final segment.
Visible resolution admits public owned, publicly imported and public inherited memberships.
Unqualified lookup starts locally and proceeds outward; visibility of qualified segments must not prohibit lexical private access.
A type inherits public and protected memberships of its general types, but not private memberships.

pilot_reference.observed_rule: Inside-scope access and inherited protected access are distinct from ordinary external access.

implementation: Handwritten native access service over collected membership identities and visibility; not an Xtend translation. Grammar cross-reference representation alone does not supply scoping.
verified_scope: Qualified local memberships; protected/private inheritance of local features, nested types and aliases; and selected named local import visibility, public re-exports and imported feature references. Alias access uses the membership visibility, not the target visibility.
remaining: Library member visibility and canonical imported membership identity; remaining import/redefinition/expression paths, ambiguity and shadowing
Callable names encoded outside QualifiedName, lambda parameter scopes and dot feature chains
